name: aiof-desktop
description: AIOF — system-native cross-platform file manager and desktop workspace
author: AIOF contributors

scripts.dist:windows: npm run build:web && electron-builder --config configs/electron-builder.json --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build:web && electron-builder --config configs/electron-builder.json --linux deb
scripts.dist:fedora: npm run build:web && electron-builder --config configs/electron-builder.json --linux rpm
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run build:web && electron-builder --config configs/electron-builder.json --linux AppImage
